name: io.github.ashishsinha1602/schemagate
description: Identity-scoped schema selection for text-to-SQL. Returns only the tables the caller may read.

environmentVariables.name: SCHEMAGATE_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: SQLAlchemy URL of the database to reflect, or 'demo' for the bundled schema

environmentVariables.name: SCHEMAGATE_CATALOG_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a JSON file with roles, hints and shadow-name overrides
